Question ID: MCR_U06_L01_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: Support-only embedded MLA.MCR.MC standards - No primary Unit 6 GM standard assigned in approved mapping

Which unit would most likely be used to measure the length of a classroom?

feedback.text: Gallons measure volume, not length. Match the unit to what is being measured before calculating.
Correct. Feet measure length and are reasonable for the size of a classroom.
Pounds measure weight, not length. The lesson focus is choosing a unit that matches the dimension.
Minutes measure time, not length. Use a length unit for classroom length.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: MCR_U06_L01_GP_Q02

MLA Standard: Support-only embedded MLA.MCR.MC standards - No primary Unit 6 GM standard assigned in approved mapping

Convert 4 feet to inches.

feedback.text: This uses an incorrect conversion factor. One foot has 12 inches, so multiply by 12.
This gives the correct number but keeps the original unit. The converted unit must be inches.
This does not convert the measurement. A conversion changes the number while keeping the same real-world length.
Correct. Since 1 foot = 12 inches, 4 x 12 = 48 inches.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: MCR_U06_L01_GP_Q03

MLA Standard: Support-only embedded MLA.MCR.MC standards - No primary Unit 6 GM standard assigned in approved mapping

Convert 120 minutes to hours.

feedback.text: Correct. Since 60 minutes = 1 hour, 120 divided by 60 = 2 hours.
This confuses the conversion fact with the answer. Divide minutes by 60 to convert to hours.
This adds 60 instead of converting. Use the equal measurement 60 minutes = 1 hour.
This multiplies by 60, which makes the number far too large when changing minutes to hours.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: MCR_U06_L01_GP_Q04

MLA Standard: Support-only embedded MLA.MCR.MC standards - No primary Unit 6 GM standard assigned in approved mapping

Which measurement describes area?

feedback.text: Feet describe length. Area uses square units.
Gallons describe volume. Area measures flat space.
Correct. Square inches describe area because the unit is squared.
Minutes describe time. The dimension must match the measurement type.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: MCR_U06_L01_GP_Q05

MLA Standard: Support-only embedded MLA.MCR.MC standards - No primary Unit 6 GM standard assigned in approved mapping

A shelf is 2 yards long. How many feet long is the shelf?

feedback.text: This does not convert yards to feet. One yard is longer than one foot.
Correct. Since 1 yard = 3 feet, 2 x 3 = 6 feet.
This uses the inches-per-foot conversion instead of yards to feet. Use 1 yard = 3 feet.
This combines unrelated conversions. Convert yards to feet with 3 feet per yard.
